화면의 배경색을 검정으로 정합니다. color.black은 준비된 검정색: Sets the screen's background color to black. color.black is a built-in black color value. You can also use colors like color.red, color.blue, and color.white.
시야 범위를 고정해 반지름만 바꾸어 비교할 수 있게 합니다. 물체의 크기: Fixes the camera view range so you can compare changes to the radius alone. It does not change the size of the object itself.
반지름 0.6인 노란 공을 만들고, 밝게 보이도록 설정합니다. 괄호 안의: Creates a yellow ball with a radius of 0.6 and sets it to look bright. Settings inside the parentheses are separated by commas. In color=color.yellow, color on the left is the setting name, and color.yellow on the right is the built-in yellow value.

Change only one setting at a time and compare the two results.

Leave the background color as is and compare only the ball's color first.

emissive=True인 공은 다른 물체도 비추나요?: Does a ball with emissive=True light up other objects too?

비교한 두 설정과 관찰 결과를 적으세요. 친구의 관찰이 다르다면 배경과: Write down the two settings you compared and what you observed. If your classmate's observation differs, check whether your background and camera viewpoint were the same.
Place balls on the left and right so you can convey meaning through position even without distinguishing colors.

두 공의 색을 같게 바꾸어도 어느 공인지 구분할 수 있을까요? 어떤 정보: If you make both balls the same color, can you still tell which ball is which? Think about what information remains.

이번에는 첫 값은 그대로입니다. 어떤 방향으로 이동했나요? 앞 실험과 나: This time, the first value stays the same. Which direction did it move? Explain by comparing it side by side with the previous experiment.

공을 만드는 두 줄 중 하나를 지우고, 남은 공의 pos만 바꾸어 보세요: Delete one of the two ball-creation lines, and try changing only the pos of the remaining ball.
위·아래로 구분하려면 vector(0, -1, 0)과 vector(0,: To distinguish using up and down, test vector(0, -1, 0) and vector(0, 1, 0) one after the other.
vector(0, -1, 0)은 처음 시점에서 어디일까요?: Where is vector(0, -1, 0) from the initial viewpoint?
가운데에서 아래로 1만큼 떨어진 곳입니다. 두 번째 값이 위아래를 정합니: It is 1 unit below the center. The second value controls up and down.
두 공의 위치를 똑같이 정하면 어떻게 보일까요?: How will it look if you set both balls to the exact same position?
두 공이 겹쳐 보입니다. 하나가 안 보인다고 삭제되었다고 판단하기 전에: The two balls overlap and look like one. Before assuming one was deleted because you can't see it, check their coordinates.
\"우리 표시에서 ___ 위치는 ___를 뜻한다. 색을 같게 해도 ___: Fill in the blanks: "In our indicator, the ___ position means ___. Even if the colors are the same, we can tell them apart because of ___."
만든 공에 이름을 붙이고 색을 바꾸어, 소리가 나는 동안 공의 색이 달라: Give a name to the ball you created and change its color to build a signal where the ball changes color while a sound plays.
이름으로 같은 물체를 다시 바꾸고, 명령의 순서가 빛과 소리의 타이밍을: I can modify the same object again using its name, and explain how the order of commands controls the timing of light and sound.
노란색으로 바꾸는 줄과 음표 줄의 순서를 바꾸면, 소리가 날 때 공은 어: If you swap the order of the line that changes the ball to yellow and the 음표 line, what color will the ball be while the sound plays?

Changing lamp.color changes the color of the existing ball instead of creating a new one. You can choose this name yourself, but you must spell it the same way every time.
코드는 위에서 아래로 실행합니다. sleep(0.5)는 0.5초 기다립니: Code runs from top to bottom. sleep(0.5) waits for 0.5 seconds. 음표("도", 0.5) plays a sound while waiting 0.5 seconds before moving to the next line. Having a waiting line makes it easy to see the change with your eyes.
파란 공이 보인 뒤 0.5초 후 노란색으로 바뀝니다. 도 소리가 나는 동: A blue ball appears, and 0.5 seconds later it turns yellow. It stays yellow while the 도 sound plays, then returns to blue when the sound ends. Instead of turning brightness on and off, it uses two colors as signal states.
Creates the ball once and refers to it again in later lines using the name lamp. Here, ... indicates omitted settings in this explanation; the actual practice code includes the full settings.
왼쪽 lamp.color는 내가 만든 공의 색, 오른쪽 color.yel: lamp.color on the left is the color of the ball you created, and color.yellow on the right is the built-in yellow value. Its size and position do not change.
그다음 줄이 실행될 때까지 노란 상태가 0.5초 유지됩니다. 음표는 소리: The yellow state stays for 0.5 seconds until the next line runs. 음표 is a command that waits for the duration of the sound.
맨 위의 sleep(0.5)는 그대로 둡니다. 어느 색이 유지되는 시간이: Leave sleep(0.5) at the top as it is. Which color stayed on screen for a different amount of time?
음표 줄을 노란색으로 바꾸는 줄 바로 위로 옮기기: Move the 음표 line right above the line that changes the color to yellow
소리가 날 때 파란색인가요, 노란색인가요? 두 색 변경 사이에 기다림이: Is it blue or yellow while the sound plays? Also think about why yellow is hard to see if there is no wait between the two color changes.
색을 구분하기 어려운 사람도 소리가 나는 때를 알아볼 수 있게 표시를 고: Change the display so that people who have trouble telling colors apart can also see when the sound is playing. Don't create a new ball; change its size instead.
lamp.radius로 소리가 나는 동안과 끝난 뒤의 크기를 다르게 정합: Use lamp.radius to set one size while the sound plays and a different size after it ends.
두 색을 같게 바꿔도 크기로 구분되는지 확인하고, 고른 크기의 이유를 설: Make the two colors the same and check that you can still tell the states apart by size. Explain why you chose those sizes.
색을 바꾼 것처럼 lamp.radius = 숫자로 크기를 바꿀 수 있습니: Just as you changed the color, you can change the size with lamp.radius = number.
음표 바로 위에 lamp.radius = 0.9를 넣고, 음표 아래에 l: Put lamp.radius = 0.9 right above the 음표 line and lamp.radius = 0.6 below it.
lamp와 Lamp는 같은 이름일까요?: Are lamp and Lamp the same name?
서로 다른 이름입니다. lamp로 만들었다면 이후에도 소문자 lamp를: No, they are different names. If you created it as lamp, you must keep using lowercase lamp afterward.
색을 바꾸는 두 줄 사이에 기다림이 없으면 어떻게 될까요?: What happens if there is no wait between the two lines that change the color?
두 변경이 매우 빠르게 일어나 중간 색을 보기 어려울 수 있습니다. 중간: The two changes happen so quickly that the color in between may be hard to see. To hold the in-between state, you need a command that waits, such as sleep or 음표.
실행 순서를 \"처음 상태 → 기다림 → 바뀐 상태와 소리 → 마지막 상: Write the run order like this: "first state → wait → changed state and sound → final state." Also add what changed when you reordered the lines.
반복할 명령을 들여쓰기로 묶고, 빛과 소리가 세 번 반복되는 과정을 따라: Group the commands to repeat with indentation, and follow how the light and sound repeat three times.
어떤 줄이 반복되는지 들여쓰기로 구분하고, 횟수와 간격을 조절할 수 있습: You can use indentation to tell which lines repeat, and you can adjust the number of repeats and the gaps between them.
라 소리와 도 소리는 각각 몇 번 날까요? 들여쓴 줄과 그렇지 않은 줄을: How many times will the 라 sound and the 도 sound each play? First, sort the lines into indented and not indented.
for count in range(3):은 안쪽 명령을 세 번 반복합니다: for count in range(3): repeats the commands inside it three times. count is a name that changes with each repeat, holding 0, 1, and 2 in turn. For now, we don't use this value in calculations and focus only on the number of repeats. The colon : at the end of the line is also required.
반복할 줄 앞에는 똑같이 공백 네 칸을 둡니다. 마지막 도 소리 줄은 들: Put the same four spaces in front of each line to repeat. The final 도 sound line is not indented, so it runs only once, after the loop ends. Indentation isn't decoration to make code look nice; it decides what the program means.
노란색과 라 소리, 파란색과 쉬는 시간이 세 번 반복됩니다. 끝에 도 소: Yellow with the 라 sound, then blue with a rest, repeats three times. At the end, the 도 sound plays once. Each round waits about 0.6 seconds: 0.3 seconds for 음표 plus 0.3 seconds for sleep.
아래 들여쓴 네 줄을 한 묶음으로 세 번 실행합니다. 한 줄씩 세 번 실: The four indented lines below run as one group, three times. It does not run one line three times and then move on to the next line.
반복 안에서 라 소리를 내며 0.3초 기다립니다. 그동안 노란색이 유지됩: Inside the loop, it plays the 라 sound and waits 0.3 seconds. The color stays yellow during that time.
It isn't indented, so it runs only once, after all three rounds are finished.
라와 도 소리가 각각 몇 번인지 세어 보세요. 도까지 다섯 번 반복되지: Count how many times the 라 and 도 sounds each play. Use indentation to explain why 도 doesn't repeat five times too.
반복 안의 sleep(0.3)만 sleep(0.6)으로 바꾸기: Change only the sleep(0.3) inside the loop to sleep(0.6)
라 소리의 길이는 그대로인가요? 빛의 어떤 상태가 더 오래 유지되었는지,: Did the length of the 라 sound stay the same? Say which light state lasted longer and how the time for one round changed.
\"급함\"과 \"여유\"를 뜻하는 두 신호를 만드세요. 반복 횟수와 쉬: Create two signals that mean "urgent" and "relaxed." Decide the number of repeats and the rest gap, and explain why you chose them.
음 이름과 소리 길이는 같게 두고, 반복 횟수와 sleep 간격을 하나씩: Keep the note name and sound length the same, and test the number of repeats and the sleep gap one at a time.
받는 사람에게 약속을 알려 준 뒤 두 신호를 구분할 수 있는지 확인합니다: Tell the receiver what the signals mean, then check whether they can tell the two signals apart.
Explain which values made the signal feel urgent or relaxed.
먼저 range의 숫자만 바꾸어 비교하고, 그다음 sleep의 숫자만 바: First change only the number in range and compare, then change only the number in sleep and compare. After checking the effects, choose the two values and finish your signal.
range의 숫자는 횟수, sleep의 숫자는 쉬는 간격입니다. 두 값을: The number in range is the count, and the number in sleep is the rest gap. Don't change both at once; check their effects separately.
기다려 주지 않는 소리 명령 비교하기: Compare the 소리 command, which doesn't wait
소리(440, 0.3)는 숫자로 음 높이를 정합니다. 440은 1초에 4: 소리(440, 0.3) sets the pitch with a number. 440 is a frequency of 440 vibrations per second, the same pitch as 라. The second value is the sound length.
반복 안의 음표(\"라\", 0.3)를 소리(440, 0.3)로 바꾸면: If you change 음표("라", 0.3) inside the loop to 소리(440, 0.3), what will happen to how long yellow shows and to the rest between sounds? Predict, then run it. Then try adding one line so yellow stays for 0.3 seconds.
소리는 음표와 달리 다음 줄을 기다리게 하지 않습니다. 소리가 끝나기 전: Unlike 음표, 소리 doesn't make the next line wait. The color turns blue before the sound ends, and the rest between sounds gets shorter. If you add sleep(0.3), indented with four spaces, right after the 소리 line, the program waits before the next command.
마지막 도 소리 줄을 네 칸 들여쓰면 어떻게 되나요?: What happens if you indent the final 도 sound line by four spaces?
반복 묶음에 들어갑니다. 매 바퀴 끝에 도 소리도 나므로 라와 도가 번갈: It joins the loop group. The 도 sound then plays at the end of every round, so 라 and 도 alternate, three times each.
for 줄에서 콜론을 빼거나 안쪽 줄의 공백 수를 다르게 하면?: What if you remove the colon from the for line, or use a different number of spaces on the inner lines?
문법 오류나 들여쓰기 오류가 날 수 있습니다. 오류에 표시된 줄과 그 위: You may get a syntax error or an indentation error. Check both the line shown in the error and the for line above it.
한 바퀴를 \"노랑과 라 0.3초 → 파랑과 쉼 0.3초\"처럼 시간 순: Write one round in time order, like "yellow and 라 for 0.3 seconds → blue and rest for 0.3 seconds." Also write what changed in the experiments where you moved or changed a wait.

실습 화면 상단의 프로젝트를 누릅니다. 작은 화면에서도 실습 화면 상단의: Click Projects at the top of the practice screen. On small screens, also click Projects at the top of the practice screen. If your current work is already saved in a project, use that project instead of creating a new one.

같은 프로젝트를 새 탭에서 다시 열기: Reopen the same project in a new tab
교재의 실습 화면 열기로 새 탭을 엽니다. 같은 계정으로 로그인된 상태에: Use Open Practice Screen in the guide to open a new tab. While logged in with the same account, click Projects, find the name you just created, and click Work on Project. Check that the saved code and run result match, and that the project name at the top is correct.
The name you chose appears in the project list, and you can reopen it with Work on Project. You haven't connected GitHub yet, so seeing GitHub Not Connected is normal.
프로젝트 이름만 보고도 어떤 작품인지 알 수 있게 정하고, 친구나 다음: Choose a project name that shows what the work is at a glance, and write one sentence explaining it to a friend or to yourself next lesson.
Reopen the project and check that the code and result are the same.
Include "who gets what signal, in what situation" in the description.
\"내 프로젝트\"보다 \"물 보충 알림\"처럼 쓰임이 드러나는 이름을: Instead of "My Project," choose a name that shows its use, like "Water Refill Alert."
다시 열었는데 다른 코드라면 프로젝트 이름과 작업하기를 누른 카드를 먼저: If you reopen it and see different code, first check the project name and the card where you clicked Work on Project.
이 단계에서 GitHub 저장소도 이미 만들어졌나요?: Has a GitHub repository already been created at this step?
No. You created it with the box unchecked, so only a VPyLab project is created. You'll connect GitHub in the next lesson.
이미 프로젝트가 있는 작품도 새로 만들어야 하나요?: Do I need to create a new project for work that already has one?
아닙니다. 목록에서 기존 작품을 열어 이어가세요. 새 프로젝트는 별도 작: No. Open the existing work from the list and continue. Create a new project only when you start a separate piece of work.
프로젝트 이름, 작품의 쓰임, 다시 열어 확인한 결과를 한 줄씩 남기세요: Write one line each for the project name, what the work is for, and what you found when you reopened it.
GitHub 계정으로 연결하고, 코드가 담긴 저장소와 실행 페이지의 차이: Connect with your GitHub account, and learn the difference between the repository that holds your code and the run page.
기존 VPyLab 프로젝트에 GitHub를 연결하고, 코드 저장소와 작품: You can connect GitHub to an existing VPyLab project, and tell the code repository apart from the address where your work runs.
친구에게 코드를 읽어 달라고 할 때와 작품을 실행해 달라고 할 때, 같은: If you ask a friend to read your code, and then ask them to run your work, should you send the same link?
저장소는 코드와 파일, 변경 이력을 담는 GitHub의 공간입니다. 커밋: A repository is a space on GitHub that holds code, files, and change history. A commit is a unit that records a group of changes you made. For now, you won't type any commands; you'll use these through VPyLab's connection and code saving.
The GitHub link shows code files like main.py and commits. The Pages link runs your project as a web page. Even after the repository is created, the run page may take a little longer to get ready.
GitHub 계정과 공개할 내용 확인하기: Check your GitHub account and what will be public
GitHub 가입은 만 13세 이상이어야 하며, 거주 지역과 학교의 이용: You must be at least 13 years old to sign up for GitHub, and you should also check the rules for your region and school. If your account is not ready yet, keep using VPyLab save and connect later. Connecting creates a public repository, so do not put your real name, contact info, or passwords in your username, code, or logs.
프로젝트 카드의 GitHub 버튼을 누릅니다. 저장소 연결 창이 열리면: Click the GitHub button on the project card. If the repository connection window opens, move to the next step. If it says authentication is required, click Connect GitHub in the notice above the list and sign in with that GitHub account. Return to the list and click the GitHub button on the same project card again.
기존 프로젝트에 저장소 만들기: Create a repository for an existing project
GitHub 저장소 연결 창에서 프로젝트 이름을 확인하고 저장소 이름을: In the GitHub repository connection window, check the project name and choose a repository name. Using lowercase English letters, numbers, and hyphens without spaces, like light-sound-signal, works well as a web address. If the name is already taken, add a number at the end. This step creates a new repository, so do not create a repository with the same name on GitHub beforehand. Click Start Connection.
준비 상태와 실제 파일 확인하기: Check the status and actual files
GitHub 준비 중이면 완료될 때까지 기다립니다. 카드에 GitHub·: If GitHub shows Preparing, wait until it finishes. Once the GitHub, Pages, and commit links appear on the card, open the GitHub link and check that the account in the address is yours. Open main.py and verify that your project code is inside.
기존 VPyLab 프로젝트에 GitHub 저장소 주소가 연결됩니다. ma: A GitHub repository address is now linked to your existing VPyLab project. main.py contains the code saved in your project and does not include unsaved edits in the editor. Pages is the run page. Distinguish Preparing or Failed statuses from a completed connection.
GitHub 인증 후 같은 프로젝트 카드에서 다시 연결합니다. 프로젝트가: After authenticating with GitHub, reconnect from the same project card. If you do not see your project, check that you are logged into the same VPyLab account as before rather than creating a new one. If you have not connected GitHub yet, you can still practice saving and restoring code in the next lesson using VPyLab save history.
자신의 프로젝트에 연결된 두 링크를 열고, \"코드를 보는 곳\"과 \": Open the two links connected to your project and tell apart "where you view the code" and "where you run the project."
Check on GitHub that the code in main.py matches your project.
Pages가 아직 준비 중이면 저장소 생성과 실행 페이지 배포를 구분해: If Pages is still preparing, record repository creation separately from run page deployment.
On the link starting with github.com, look through the file list.
Pages가 처음에 404로 보이면 잠시 뒤 다시 열어 봅니다. 계속 안: If Pages shows 404 at first, wait a moment and open it again. If it still does not work, check the connection notice, re-authenticate with GitHub, and save your code again in the project.
GitHub 버튼을 눌렀으면 연결이 완료된 것인가요?: Is the connection finished as soon as I click the GitHub button?
아닙니다. 준비 중일 수 있고 실패할 수도 있습니다. 카드의 연결 상태와: No. It might still be preparing, or it might have failed. Check the connection status on the card and the actual files on GitHub.
GitHub 계정이 없으면 작품을 저장하지 못하나요?: Can I not save my project without a GitHub account?
VPyLab 로그인 후 프로젝트에 저장할 수 있습니다. GitHub 계정: You can save to your project after logging into VPyLab. A GitHub account is only needed at the step where you connect a GitHub repository.
저장소 주소와 실행 주소를 구분해 적고, main.py에서 확인한 코드: Write down the repository address and the run address separately, and note one part of the code you verified in main.py.
Change and save one part at a time, and use work logs and previous code restore.
코드 저장과 기록 남기기를 구분하고, 이전 코드를 복원해 실행한 뒤 원하: You can distinguish between saving code and leaving a log, restore previous code to run it, and save the state you want again.
\"친구가 소리 간격이 짧다고 해서 늘렸다\"는 메모만 남기면 코드도 바: If you only leave a note saying "My friend said the sound interval was too short, so I made it longer," will the code change too? Think about code changes and work notes as separate actions.
코드 저장과 기록 남기기: Saving code and leaving a log
코드 저장은 먼저 VPyLab에 남고, 연결된 GitHub에는 커밋으로: Saving code saves it to VPyLab first, while the connected GitHub repository may update a little later as a commit or be held pending. Leaving a log records what you did, where you got stuck, and what to do next without changing the code. Writing a log does not mean the code you are editing has been saved.
복원은 이전 상태로 다시 실험하기: Restoring lets you experiment again from an earlier state
저장 이력에서 이전 코드를 고르면 VPyLab 저장 코드와 에디터가 함께: When you pick an earlier version from Save History, both the saved VPyLab code and the editor update together. The saved version and editor draft from before the restore are kept in history. Since the latest code on GitHub does not change automatically, run the project to verify it and use Save Code to apply it.
비교할 첫 상태 저장하기: Save the first state for comparison
자신의 프로젝트를 열고 먼저 실행합니다. 저장을 눌러 작업 남기기에서 코: Open your project and run it first. Click Save and choose Save Code under Leave Work. Enter a title like "Default signal before comparison" and save. If it is your first session or you are returning after a while, you may be asked for a reflection log first—fill out the reflection log, then check Save History to make sure the code was saved.
한 부분만 바꾸어 저장하기: Change and save just one part
소리 길이, 쉬는 간격, 공 크기 중 하나만 바꿉니다. 실행 결과를 확인: Change only one thing: sound duration, rest interval, or ball size. Check the result by running it, then enter a save title like "Increased rest interval from 0.2s to 0.5s". Find that title in Tools → Save History. If GitHub is connected, check the sync notice and refresh main.py to find the changed value. You can also check the change via the commit link on the card.
변경 이유 기록하기: Log the reason for the change
저장에서 기록 남기기를 선택합니다. 한 일에는 바꾼 이유와 관찰 결과를: In Save, select Leave Log. Under What I Did, write why you made the change and what you observed, plus any blockers and next steps if needed. This action does not overwrite your current code.
지금 수정한 코드를 먼저 코드 저장으로 남깁니다. 도구 → 저장 이력에서: First, save the code you just edited using Save Code. In Tools → Save History, find the version from before the comparison, restore it, and run it. If you want to keep the earlier code, use Save Code in that state. If you want to keep the changed code, restore that version from history again, run it, and save. Check Save History, and if GitHub is connected, check main.py as well.
두 상태를 알아볼 수 있는 저장 제목과 변경 이유가 남습니다. 복원 후에: You now have clear save titles for both states along with the reason for the change. After restoring, both the saved VPyLab code and the editor switch to the selected version. To apply it to GitHub, you need to use Save Code.
GitHub 미연결 상태에서는 저장 이력에서 코드 저장과 복원 결과를 확: When GitHub is not connected, check your code save and restore results in Save History. Checking main.py and commits can wait until after you connect GitHub.
친구가 제안한 개선 한 가지를 시험하세요. 바꾸기 전과 후를 각각 저장하: Test one improvement suggested by a friend. Save both the before and after states, and decide which state to keep based on what you observe.
Change only one element so you can compare under the same conditions.
The save title clearly shows what changed, and the log explains why.
복원 후 실행 결과와 저장 이력을 확인하고, GitHub 연결 후에는 m: After restoring, check the run result and Save History, and if GitHub is connected, check main.py too.
Instead of "Fixed" or "Done," write what you changed and its value in the title.
메모만 추가했다면 에디터의 수정 코드는 아직 저장하지 않은 것일 수 있습: If you only added a note, the edited code in your editor might not be saved yet. Make sure you used Save Code.
GitHub 반영 보류가 나오면 VPyLab 저장 이력을 먼저 확인하고: If GitHub sync is pending, check VPyLab Save History first, then follow the GitHub connection instructions to authenticate and save again.
기록 남기기로 소리가 길어진 이유를 적으면 코드도 저장되나요?: If I write why the sound got longer using Leave Log, does that also save the code?
아닙니다. 기록은 코드와 별개입니다. 코드를 수정했다면 코드 저장을 사용: No. Logs are separate from code. If you edited the code, you must use Save Code to update the latest code.
이전 코드로 복원했는데 GitHub가 그대로인 이유는?: Why is GitHub unchanged after I restored an earlier version of the code?
Because restoring the saved code and editor is a separate step from syncing to GitHub. Run the code to check it, then use Save Code to sync.
\"바꾼 요소 / 예상 / 실제 관찰 / 최종으로 남긴 상태와 이유\"를: Write down "Changed element / Prediction / Actual observation / Final state kept and why." The reason behind your choice matters more than how many times you saved.
작품 실행 링크와 팀 초대 코드를 구분하고, 친구의 피드백으로 한 번 더: Distinguish between the project run link and the team invite code, and improve your project one more time with a friend's feedback.
친구가 실행할 링크를 고르고, 함께 편집할 때 필요한 VPyLab 초대와: You can pick the right link for a friend to run your project, and tell apart VPyLab invites and GitHub permissions needed for editing together.
작품을 구경할 친구와 코드를 함께 고칠 친구에게 각각 무엇을 보내야 할까: What should you send to a friend who just wants to try your project versus a friend who will edit the code with you?
작품을 보여 줄 때는 Pages 실행 링크를 보냅니다. VPyLab에서: When showing your project, send the Pages run link. When editing together in VPyLab, use the project's invite code. Knowing the run address does not give someone permission to edit the project.
A VPyLab invite code grants permission to edit and save together inside the app. For a teammate to push changes directly to the GitHub repository as well, they also need a GitHub collaborator invite and must accept it. A GitHub invite alone does not add them to the VPyLab project.
프로젝트 카드의 Pages를 열어 최종 저장한 작품인지 확인합니다. 친구: Open Pages on the project card to make sure it shows your latest saved project. Send your friend the run link along with a one-sentence guide on how to use it. If needed, tell them to click the Run button and ask whether the sound plays.
피드백을 받아 한 부분 고치기: Get feedback and improve one part
친구에게 \"신호가 어떤 뜻으로 보였는지\", \"헷갈린 점은 무엇인지\: Ask your friend "What did the signal seem to mean?" and "What was confusing?" Pick one suggestion, update and run your code, and then use Save Code. After checking that main.py is updated, ask your friend to open the run page again. The run page may take a little longer to update, so if the old screen still appears, wait a moment and refresh.
같이 편집할 친구 초대하기: Invite a friend to edit together
함께 만들 경우 프로젝트 카드의 멤버를 열어 VPyLab 초대 코드를 편: If you are building together, open Members on the project card and share the VPyLab invite code directly with the friend who will edit with you. Your teammate logs in, enters the invite code in the input box on the project list, and joins. Confirm that you both see the same project name, then decide on your work order. If you are working alone, you can skip this step.
GitHub 직접 반영 권한은 필요할 때 추가하기: Add direct GitHub sync permissions when needed
팀원도 GitHub에 직접 반영해야 한다면 멤버 화면의 공동 작업자 초대: If a teammate also needs to sync directly to GitHub, use the collaborator invite in the Members view. The repository owner invites the teammate's account on GitHub, and once the teammate accepts, they re-authenticate with GitHub in VPyLab. You can start with saving inside the app only, and check sync permissions and results in the save notice.
친구가 실행 링크에서 작품을 확인하고, 피드백을 반영한 변경을 다시 볼: Your friend can check the project via the run link and see the updated version after you apply their feedback. Teams editing together verify both VPyLab membership and GitHub sync permissions separately.
GitHub나 Pages가 아직 준비되지 않았다면 내 실습 화면에서 친구: If GitHub or Pages is not ready yet, ask your friend to run the project and interpret the signal directly on your practice screen. You can check the run link once the connection is complete.
작품을 처음 보는 사람 한 명에게 실행과 신호 해석을 부탁하고, 피드백: Ask someone seeing your project for the first time to run it and interpret the signal, apply one piece of feedback, and have them check it again.
실행 링크와 짧은 사용법을 전달합니다. 아직 연결하지 않았다면 내 실습: Share the run link and a short guide on how to use it. If you have not connected yet, let them run it on your practice screen.
Save and log what you changed based on actual observations or feedback.
팀이라면 누가 어느 부분을 고칠지 정하고, 팀원이 저장한 뒤 프로젝트를: If you are in a team, decide who will edit which part, and after a teammate saves, reopen the project to check the latest code before continuing.
First, check from the recipient's perspective that the page opens and runs properly.
Instead of asking vaguely what it meant, ask which of the two states it looked like.
같은 부분을 동시에 고치기보다 한 명이 저장한 뒤 다른 사람이 최신 코드: Rather than editing the same part at the same time, have one person save first and the next person check the latest code before continuing.
Pages 링크를 공유하면 상대도 코드를 바꿀 수 있나요?: If I share the Pages link, can the other person change my code too?
실행 링크 자체는 편집 권한을 주지 않습니다. 다만 연결된 저장소는 공개: The run link itself does not grant editing permission. However, because the connected repository is public, anyone can view the code. To edit together in VPyLab, they must join the project using the invite code.
GitHub 공동작업자 초대를 수락하면 VPyLab에도 합류하나요?: Does accepting a GitHub collaborator invite also add someone to VPyLab?
별도입니다. VPyLab 초대 코드로 합류해야 앱 안에서 함께 작업할 수: They are separate. They must join with the VPyLab invite code to work together inside the app.
\"받은 피드백 / 바꾼 코드와 이유 / 다시 실행해 확인한 결과 / 다: Write down "Feedback received / Changed code and why / Result after running again / What to work on together next."
